summary: radicale is a CalDAV/CardDAV server (WebDAV) with concrete filesystem storage backends: one folder per collection and one file per calendar/addressbook object. Mined the multifilesystem storage (Collection, CalendarItem, derived item/SyncToken caches) and the CSV/file sharing database (Share), plus the htpasswd account backend. Impl atoms are the WebDAV protocol ops (MKCALENDAR/MKCOL/PUT/PROPPATCH/DELETE/REPORT/GET/PROPFIND/MOVE), the sync-collection REPORT (writes SyncToken), the sharing HTTP API (POST /.sharing/v1) and the internal login path. Guard edges are the per-operation Access.check rights gate and share owner/user checks; storage.write_goal ops unguarded by a route middleware instead gate on discovery existence.

_no_edges.why: the auth entrypoint itself; no prior auth wall exists by definition (radicale/app/__init__.py:541-558 calls auth.login); it triggers nothing downstream directly
